open_points.subject: store.spool_file + store.record_change attempt numbering for function/read file outputs
open_points.text: `public_op:store.spool_file` Inputs: "the producing attempt — `run_id`, node, `map_index`, `attempt_number`" / `store` "assigns `attempt_number` inside each change that writes a NodeExecution or an EffectAttempt"
open_points.question: Before `record_run_progress` / `record_read_outcome` writes the NodeExecution (where `store` assigns the next attempt number), what exact attempt_number must callers pass to `store.spool_file` for files produced by function nodes and `read` operation nodes?
options: Caller computes next ordinal from existing NodeExecutions and passes it to `spool_file`
`spool_file` accepts no attempt_number and `store` binds files to the attempt during `record_change`
Caller stages files outside spool and only publishes after `record_change` returns the assigned attempt_number
open_points.default_guess: Caller computes the next ordinal and passes it, relying on one-writer sequencing.

open_points.subject: Atomic scope of per-attempt spool rollback on ceiling failure
open_points.text: `public_op:store.spool_file` Errors: "`refused` over a spool ceiling, nothing kept of that file or of any file that attempt spooled before (A15 rule 3)"
open_points.question: Given `spool_file` takes one file per call, how is "any file that attempt spooled before" guaranteed to be removed when a later file in the same attempt crosses a ceiling?
options: `store` tracks files by attempt and deletes prior files of that attempt on failure
Caller must spool all files of an attempt in one batched call
Prior files may remain and caller cleans them up explicitly
open_points.default_guess: `store` tracks per-attempt spool entries and removes earlier files of that attempt when refusing.

open_points.subject: Mapping instance-selection/address failures to `operation_failed` detail codes
open_points.text: A08 rule 5: "the installation selects no instance for the service or that instance has no `api_base_url` — one that is not an absolute `http` or `https` URL with a host counts as none" / State 5 closed detail set includes both `instance_not_selected` and `instance_address_missing`
open_points.question: Exactly which runtime subcases map to `instance_not_selected` vs `instance_address_missing` (including selected instance name missing from manifest, missing instance entry fields, or invalid URL)?
options: Only "no selected instance name" -> `instance_not_selected`; all selected-but-unusable cases -> `instance_address_missing`
open_points.default_guess: Use `instance_not_selected` only when installation has no selected name; otherwise selected but unusable/missing/invalid address cases use `instance_address_missing`.
